title: Remote viewing research and practice module authored and verified
summary: The isolated Research module now provides an evidence-balanced STARGATE history, a mechanism-hypothesis map, a six-stage CRV practice manual, a stricter experimental protocol, a printable worksheet, 24 reviewed source records, 24 graded claims, a clearly non-research 12-target demonstration pool, and a tested blind-task integrity tool without changing generated site or registry-selection surfaces owned by active parallel lanes.
intent: Close the authored-module lane with a usable practice and research system that honors the requested first-principles possibility stance while keeping practice assumptions, empirical evidence, causal theories, operational value, source rights, and future registry promotion explicitly separate.
reasoning: Research remains the correct owning section because remote viewing combines declassified history, laboratory design, practitioner method, operational-use claims, and unresolved causal questions; History and declassified-document collections can later project the Work through typed relationships.

The module deliberately supports practice under a provisional possibility premise while requiring opaque cues, role separation, target commitments, transcript locks, decoy judging, complete trial accounting, and falsification rules before any evidential claim advances.

The evidence record is represented as mixed rather than promotional or dismissive: positive studies, explicit null and low-correlation sessions, critiques, the AIR laboratory-versus-operations split, opposing expert interpretations, later synthesis, and current expert opinion remain distinguishable evidence types.

CRV terms such as Matrix, signal line, ideogram, and AOL are preserved as historically documented practitioner vocabulary; no physical, telepathic, clairvoyant, precognitive, or decision-augmentation mechanism is promoted as established.

External government records, manuals, papers, and feedback media remain upstream-owned and linked rather than copied; the widely circulated 1986 CRV manual is correctly described as an externally preserved practitioner-archive document without an established CIA Reading Room identity or official DIA document number.

The active People Graph lane owns the next whole-Library Snapshot and related registry surfaces, and the UNSOLVEABLE Mathematics lane owns root documentation indexes, so this completed lane remains path-isolated and defers Work, Release, Source Inventory, Snapshot, and generated-site promotion.

changes.summary: Added the Research placement, three-track operating stance, evidence boundary, CRV stage overview, first-session workflow, safety rules, and formal promotion gates.
Added a source-led history from early SRI work through AIR and current literature, including positive, null, low-correlation, ambiguous, foreign-assessment, and operational-utility evidence.

Separated operational procedure, practitioner phenomenology, and causal explanation, then defined discriminating tests for leakage, judging, statistical artifacts, telepathy, clairvoyance, precognition, decision augmentation, CRV signal-line theory, and hybrid accounts.

Added a complete six-stage beginner CRV workflow with role separation, AOL handling, transcript locking, blind judging, feedback, an eight-week programme, metrics, failure modes, and ethical boundaries.
Added preregistration, target design, randomization, commitment, blinding, transcript sanitation, judging, statistical, adversarial-control, AI-use, replication, and release contracts.
Added a printable worksheet spanning pre-session state, Stages I through VI, transcript lock, blind judging, reveal, post-feedback learning, and ledger closeout.
Added a selective source index resolving 24 government, practitioner, experimental, critical, review, and expert-opinion records with explicit evidence roles, limitations, and rights notes.
Added 24 claims classified as documented record, source-reported positive, source-reported negative, contested, not established, unknown, or methodological rule, each with sources and an update gate.
Added a 12-target contrast pool for tooling rehearsal with an explicit prohibition on treating it as a formal research pool.

Added a standard-library blind-task tool that creates target-free public tasks, private nonce-backed SHA-256 commitments, immutable transcript locks, verified reveal receipts, and overwrite protection.
Added seven integration and tamper tests covering target leakage, full assignment-lock-reveal flow, altered assignments, changed transcripts, overwrite attempts, and duplicate targets.
Added the offline module gate for file presence, JSON shape, source/claim integrity, rights notes, relative links, publication safety, Python compilation, and target-manager tests.
Recorded scope, placement, truth and tool boundaries, validation, source and rights limits, promotion sequence, next research, and merge-safe paths.

evidence.summary: Twenty-four source records were classified across government archives, practitioner history, early positive experiments, failed replications and critiques, independent reviews, opposing AIR expert assessments, modern empirical work, meta-analysis, and current expert guidance.
The offline verifier passed with 24 sources, 24 claims, 12 demonstration targets, 14 relative links checked, 161 source-ID mentions, 16 publication-safe files scanned, and seven target-manager tests.
All 16 module files stored on GitHub matched the locally validated Git blob identities byte for byte before the completion Event was appended.
Before closeout the branch was 17 commits ahead and zero behind canonical main, and its diff contained exactly the 16 reserved module files.

The module was built and validated without a full repository checkout; authoritative pull-request CI must still run the repository-wide npm verification, immutable-history, generated-site, link, and publication gates.

next_actions: Run the full repository npm verification gate in the draft pull-request environment and preserve the exact CI verdict.
Obtain independent review from at least one methodologically sympathetic and one critical reviewer before promotion.
Run at least ten clean pilot sessions to demonstrate that assignment, lock, judging, reveal, and ledger workflows are usable without target leakage.
Review page-level provenance and rights for every source, then create a reference-only Source Inventory rather than importing the external document payloads.

After active registry and index lanes close, register an independent Remote Viewing Research and Practice Work, publish an immutable Release pinned to an exact commit, select it in a successor whole-Library Snapshot, and generate its public reading surface.
Build a primary-source foreign-programme inventory that separates Soviet or Russian records from U.S. intelligence assessments, translations, memoirs, and later retellings.
